name: Celcomdigi Berhad
overview: 2026年，CelcomDigi 在 Digital Nasional Berhad (DNB) 的股东安排下支付了 RM327.87 million 的期权价格，并额外提供 RM202 million 的股东垫款，涉及电信基础设施服务板块。同时，集团完成了 Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd. 的强制清盘解散，该实体属于数字与电商服务相关业务。其他公告主要为股息派发、委员会人事变动及股东大会等常规事项。
overview_en: In 2026, CelcomDigi made a payment of RM327.87 million for the option price and provided an additional shareholder advance of RM202 million under the Digital Nasional Berhad (DNB) shareholders' arrangement, involving the telecommunication infrastructure services segment. Meanwhile, the group completed the compulsory winding-up and dissolution of Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd., an entity related to digital and e-commerce services.

segments.name: 电信基础设施服务
segments.note: 今年主要涉及对 Digital Nasional Berhad (DNB) 的股东垫款及期权支付。
segments.note_en: This year mainly involved shareholder advances and option payment to Digital Nasional Berhad (DNB).

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 应 DNB 要求，CelcomDigi 于 2026 年 4 月 29 日向 DNB 提供 RM202,000,000 的额外股东垫款。
actions.text_en: At DNB's request, CelcomDigi provided RM202,000,000 as Additional Shareholder Advance to DNB on 29 April 2026.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: CelcomDigi 于 2026 年 3 月 6 日根据 Put Notice 条款支付期权价格 RM327,872,640.28，并承接其比例的 MoF Inc. 贷款及应计利息和额外股东垫款合计 RM161,172,639.95。
actions.text_en: CelcomDigi made payment of RM327,872,640.28 for the Option Price pursuant to the Put Notice on 6 March 2026, and took over its proportionate share of the MoF Inc.

segments.name: 数字与电商服务
segments.note: 今年完成 Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd. 的清盘解散。
segments.note_en: This year completed the winding-up and dissolution of Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd. 的清盘人于 2025 年 8 月 28 日召开最终会议，新加坡高等法院于 2026 年 4 月 28 日下令清盘人获释且该公司即时解散。
actions.text_en: The liquidator of Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd. convened the final meeting on 28 August 2025, and the High Court of Singapore on 28 April 2026 ordered the liquidator to be released and the company to be dissolved with immediate effect.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 集团完成 Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd. 的强制清盘解散，退出该实体相关业务。
model_changes.text_en: The group completed the compulsory winding-up and dissolution of Infront Consulting Group (S) Pte. Ltd., exiting the business related to this entity.
